page_title: LOR 1-1 NIC | Lorient v Nice 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
90+4' Half-chance! Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) plays a pass into the box, but Marcin Bulka reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+3' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Bilal Brahimi (Nice) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
89' A player from Nice commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
88' Bilal Brahimi (Nice) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
88' Bilal Brahimi (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gaetan Laborde.
88' Melvin Bard (Nice) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
86' Regis Le Bris prepares a substitution. Julien Ponceau is replaced by Bonke Innocent (Lorient).
84' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) launches a cross from the corner, but Yvon Mvogo is alert to thwart the effort.
83' The resulting corner from Gaetan Laborde (Nice) comes to nothing.
83' A substitution has been made. Evann Guessand goes off and Terem Moffi (Nice) comes on.
82' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Corner kick. Nice will have an opportunity.
81' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Badredine Bouanani (Nice) is replacing Sofiane Diop.
78' Here is a change. Morgan Sanson is going off and Francesco Farioli gives the last tactical orders to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
77' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Eli Junior Kroupi laid the ball off to Sirine Doucoure (Lorient), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
75' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj saw the whole situation.
71' Bamba Dieng is substituted due to injury. Regis Le Bris gives a chance to Sirine Doucoure (Lorient).
71' Substitution. Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jean-Victor Makengo walks off.
70' Looks like Bamba Dieng (Lorient) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
69' Sofiane Diop (Nice) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
68' Evann Guessand (Nice) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nice.
66' Hakim Ben El Hadj sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
65' The Nice players halt their celebrations as referee Hakim Ben El Hadj makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
64' 0 - 1 Goal! Evann Guessand (Nice) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:1.
64' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' Evann Guessand (Nice) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play and Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
62' A pass by Melvin Bard (Nice) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
61' The linesman raises his flag. Evann Guessand (Nice) is adjudged offside.
57' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) replaces Vincent Le Goff.
57' Substitution. Abdoul Bamo Meite is replaced by Theo Le Bris (Lorient).

54' Evann Guessand (Nice) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Yvon Mvogo anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
53' Julien Laporte (Lorient) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Morgan Sanson (Nice) was quite harsh and Hakim Ben El Hadj didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Morgan Sanson (Nice) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
50' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
50' Morgan Sanson (Nice) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
49' Nice failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

49' Yvon Mvogo was forced into action to thwart Khephren Thuram (Nice). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
49' Melvin Bard (Nice) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
47' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Flag up against Bamba Dieng (Lorient). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45+1' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the shot whistles inches wide of the left post.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Nice win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
42' A crossfield pass from Gaetan Laborde (Nice) fails to find any of his teammates.
38' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Nice players are visibly unhappy with the call.

37' Play continues despite the shouts by some Nice players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
36' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
35' Evann Guessand (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Nice earn a corner.
33' The referee blows his whistle after Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.

31' What a poor attempt! Khephren Thuram (Nice) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
28' The Nice players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
26' Morgan Sanson (Nice) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
26' The ball is cleared after Khephren Thuram (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Nice win a corner kick.
23' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.
21' Evann Guessand (Nice) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
19' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
16' Hakim Ben El Hadj couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dante (Nice) and blew his whistle.
15' There's a distinct lack of options for Melvin Bard (Nice), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post.
14' Nice are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
12' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
10' Khephren Thuram (Nice) jumps into a tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj signals a foul.
9' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo was alert and made a comfortable save.
8' Youcef Atal (Nice) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
7' A pass from Morgan Sanson (Nice) is intercepted by Yvon Mvogo and the move breaks down.
5' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gaetan Laborde (Nice) who sends his header well wide of the right post.
3' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
Nice will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Hakim Ben El Hadj.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
